caption:
Inflation is still running hot. 🔥

BLS says consumer prices rose 3.7% over the 12 months to September. Gasoline was up 34.2% over the year, while food was up 2.5%.

And the Fed meeting wraps up today, so a lot of people are watching rates.

Which price hits you hardest right now?
